material_result: Preserving a fixed cross-stratum latent transfer map instead of rectangularizing marginal worst cases materially improved worst-case reject-by-deadline in the tested paired-sign problem. T=20/T=50 hit the inverted-map upper bound on the discretized Bellman model; T=100/T=200 searched policies came within 0.0145/0.106 percentage point of that universal upper bound. Maximin power and minimax regret selected materially different policies.

termination.exact_next_action: Implement a higher-resolution three-map belief-state Bellman solver for the fixed-latent T=100/T=200 game, search the least-favorable prior over the map simplex, verify saddle/equalizer conditions and test whether history-driven latent-map learning closes the remaining numerical upper-bound gaps; then add harmful q<=.5 maps and asymmetric costs.
